description: Lignes haute tension aériennes (EDF) à La Réunion is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data de La Réunion, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by EDF-SEI. Ce jeu de données présente l'ensemble des lignes haute tension (HTA) aériennes de l'île de la Réunion. Ces données sont publiées à titre purement indicatif, EDF ne peut garantir leur exactitude et leur exhaustivité. Des mises à jour seront publiées régulièrement. Mis a jour en Fevrier 2020. Coverage: La Réunion. The portal files it under Aménagement durable du territoire. Its keywords are Lignes, HTA, Réseau, Aérien. The portal shows 4,211 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-regionreunion-com-portal.
